dimensions.expression: CASE WHEN amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END
dimensions.name: size_class

args.message: I classified each order as 'big' if its amount is over 100 and 'small' otherwise. I did this inside the query, so the stored model is unchanged. Any order with no amount would count as 'small'; I didn't check whether there are any. The changes for January are measured against December 2024, which had 32 big and 114 small orders. In total there were 159 orders in January 2025, 144 in February and 146 in March.
